opening.argument: The presentation shows viewers how the Coinbase Earn rewards are obtained: watch educational videos, complete a quiz after each one, and receive cryptocurrency in a Coinbase wallet for each completed quiz. The creator walks through those lessons and quizzes on screen. He also points nonmembers to a sign-up link and describes a free-crypto offer. Separately, he shows a Bitcoin giveaway drawing and asks viewers to subscribe to his channel. Those requests are part of a tutorial and promotion with stated reward conditions; the evidence does not establish deceptive solicitation or show that any viewer suffered a loss.
